honesty: Draft curricula assembled from the registries; nothing invented. No model has taught any lesson, no person or robot has been assessed here, and no lesson is certified: certification is a human/steward act. Advisors are scripted guides and deliver only their own scripted orientation; Omegas are defined, not seated, and deliver nothing.
